description: Read the privacy-safe candidate dossier linked to an OpenTrain proposal: masked profile, proposal summary, AI-interview summary, verification verdicts (incl. identity assurance and current-location decision detail), factual engagement disposition, neutral links, and review/contract roll-ups with a stable asOf timestamp plus explicit availability/missing/redactions/provenance metadata. Optional strict evidence:"full" (DEV-2923) adds ten bounded metadata-only evidence families (cap 25 items each, truthful truncation, typed continuation); omitted means concise with evidence null. Requires candidate_dossier:read scope, the default-off candidate-dossier agent surface, and a claimed account. Hidden or banned candidates read as not found; contact details, raw resumes, government IDs, message bodies/participants, provider/session references, and assessment contents or runtime internals (including cross-buyer private assessments) are never returned, and full evidence carries no compensation amounts and no coordinates/IP/ASN/timezone data. Candidate-authored free text (profile fields and the AI-interview summary) is sanitized with explicit [REDACTED_*] placeholders recorded as PRIVACY_MASKED redactions.

evidence.description: Strict evidence mode (DEV-2923): omitted means concise (evidence null in the response); "full" adds the ten bounded metadata-only evidence families (cap 25 items each, truthful truncation, typed continuation). Exact lowercase values only.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal (job offer) id the candidate dossier is linked to.

name: opentrain_get_candidate_dossier
